items.question: Is the sync automatic or manually triggered?
items.answer: After scraping, you can one-click sync results to Lark Base. Fields are mapped automatically — content, comments, keywords, and account data flow into the right tables without copy-paste.

items.question: How do monitoring reports reach Lark?
items.answer: Configure your Lark webhook in the extension. The system scans monitored accounts daily, generates a summary report pushed to Lark Bot, and writes matched content details into your Lark Base tables for team review.

items.question: Can multiple team members sync to the same Lark Base?
items.answer: Yes. The template organizes data by platform, account, and content type. Each team member uses the extension independently, and all data flows into a shared Lark Base with unified structure.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to set up the integration?
items.answer: No. Install the extension, authorize your Lark account, select a target table, and map fields — the entire setup is guided and requires no coding.
